title: Model Reference Adaptive Control
text: Compute control actions to make controlled system track reference model, 3 inputs, 4 outputs, {Feature type} sets Disturbance model feature type; {A} sets the nominal model state matrix, {B} sets the nominal model control effective, {Am} sets the reference model state, {Bm} sets the reference model control effective, {Ahat} sets the estimator plant model state matrix, {Adapt Ahat} sets the option to adapt estimator plant model state, {Learning rate (gamma_a)} sets the learning rate for adapting estimator plant model state, {Use learning modification} sets the option to enable learning modification for updating the estimator model state, {Bhat} sets the estimator plant model control effective, {Adapt Bhat} sets the option to adapt estimator plant model control effective, {Learning rate (gamma_b)} sets the learning rate for adapting estimator plant model control effective, {Specify estimator feedback gain} sets the option to enable specification of estimator feedback, {Estimator feedback gain}, {Output estimated parameters} sets the option to output estimator state and control effective, {Feedback gains}, {Adapt feedback gains} sets the option to adapt feedback gains, {Learning rate (gamma_x)} sets the learning rate for adapting feedback gains, {Feedforward gains}, {Adapt feedforward gains} sets the option to adapt feedforward gains, {Learning rate (gamma_r)} sets the learning rate for adapting feedforward, {Enable disturbance adaptation} sets the option to enable adaptation to system disturbances, {Learning rate (gamma_w)} sets the learning rate for adapting disturbance model, {Channel learning rate (Q)} sets the channel learning rate used for the Lyapunov, {Number of RBF centers} sets the number of radial basis function centers for disturbance, {Centers min} sets the lower limit for radial basis function, {Centers max} sets the upper limit for radial basis function, {Bandwidth} sets the radial basis function standard deviation, {Number of neurons in hidden layer}, {Hidden layer learning rate (gamma_v)} sets the learning rate for updating neural network, {Output disturbance/uncertancy estimate} sets the option to output disturbance and uncertainty, {Modification Methods} sets the modification method for updating, {Sigma} sets the momentum weight for parameter updates, {Use discrete-time integration in adaptation}, {Sample time} and {Integration method} sets the discrete integration method. Values come from the instance.
